newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iraq says no need for Turkish security zone.
newsitem.headline: Iraq says no need for Turkish security zone.

text.p: Iraq said on Thursday it was no longer necessary for Turkey to set up a proposed security zone in northern Iraq after a Baghdad-backed Kurdish militia took control of the region earlier this week.
"There are new facts in the north of Iraq. That area is no longer free for all," Iraqi presidential adviser Hamed Youssef Hummadi told reporters after two days of talks with Turkish officials.
